name: imo-health-clinical-intelligence
description: Clinical terminology normalization, knowledge graph navigation, and code-system cross-mapping powered by IMO Health MCP. Includes skills for diagnosis specificity, entity extraction, term normalization, and cross-code mapping across ICD-10, SNOMED CT, CPT, RxNorm, and 10+ coding systems.

interface.shortDescription: Clinical terminology normalization, search, and knowledge graph via IMO Health MCP
interface.longDescription: Connect to IMO Health's MCP server for AI-powered clinical terminology workflows. Normalize medical terms across Problem, Procedure, Medication, and Lab domains. Navigate the IMO Knowledge Graph to find the most specific ICD-10 codes. Extract clinical entities from free text. Map between ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, CPT, RxNorm, and 10+ code systems. Includes 6 guided skills for common clinical informatics workflows.
defaultPrompt: Normalize 'type 2 diabetes with kidney disease' and find the most specific ICD-10 code.
Extract all clinical entities from this discharge summary.
What refinements are available for hypertension?
